summary: Certified MODEL-PSR-WORLDWISE-ALTERNATING satisfies the existing existence-PSR and soundness conditions and has a necessary particular bearer, yet violates one invariant explanation token for that bearer; existing MODEL-PSR-INTRINSIC satisfies the stable-reason alternative. Verified both the stable-to-worldwise implication and a converse conditional on a real existence witness and cross-world reason invariance, plus an incompatibility rule for disjoint reasons. Relative to rigid token identities and a universal two-world frame only; metaphysical explanatory adequacy, reason identity and any classical-theist inference remain open. See docs/modal-quantifier-shift-models.md and #465.
